title: SWF: moving blend-mode instance across frames strips blend mode (PO2 Move)
description: In compile.ts, the posChanged update branch for type='instance' (around lines 2245-2294) has no hasBlend check. It emits either encodePlaceObject2WithCXForm (if colorEffect present) or encodePlaceObject2Move — both PO2 tags with no blend mode field — stripping the blend mode after any frame-to-frame position/scale/rotation change. The blend mode is visible on frame 1 (isFirst path correctly uses PO3) but disappears on frame 2+ when the object moves. Fix: add a hasBlend check in the posChanged instance branch and emit a PO3 Move tag (add a move=true or isMove flag to encodePlaceObject3WithBlendMode in filters.ts, or create a new variant).
